summary: This tutorial covers how to apply backgrounds and customize slide layouts in LibreOffice Impress using Linux. It explains how to create and apply custom backgrounds across all slides by modifying the slide master. The process involves opening a sample presentation, selecting the slide master, and applying a white background to the first slide. The tutorial also demonstrates changing text color to black for better visibility against a white background. Additionally, it shows how to apply a light blue background and save these changes as a new slide master. The guide then moves on to adding design elements like logos and shapes, specifically creating a rectangle in the title area of a slide using the basic shapes toolbar. Overall, the tutorial provides step-by-step instructions for enhancing presentations with custom designs and layouts in LibreOffice Impress.
